shots.graphic: Push in on the dial at 5; 'The heating's on.' swings onto the arc; radiator ticks, snow outside
Duvet drops onto the radiator with a squash; 'The duvet's out.' rises under the dial
Rose heat floods up from the radiator, frost melts, duvet flung off; 'And you're / on fire.'
Four notches down, 5 to 1; each click swaps the arc tip and the line below; the room cools a step each time; Source: NHS
Frost grows back on the window, calm push; 'Save this for / tonight.'; calm hold
